01 / A PERSONAL STORY
01 — The beginning

It started
with a racket.

In university, I joined my school's college badminton team. What began as a sport became a place to belong — a reason to train harder, show up for each other, and celebrate every small win.

I wanted this page to feel less like a list of achievements and more like what badminton really means to me: friendship, persistence and shared memories.

02 — From player to captain

Better.
Together.

Later, I became the captain of our college badminton team. I helped organize training and matches, and we achieved what I recorded as the team's best result at the time. Being captain changed my perspective: playing well mattered, but helping everyone move forward mattered more.

A team is more than the sum of its players.
🏅
5th Place · 2023 Team TournamentSouth China University of Technology · Certificate shown alongside
03 — The story continues

New campus.
Same passion.

At Tsinghua, I continued training and joining badminton events with new teammates. The competitions and the honors that followed are all part of this chapter.

04 — Beyond the court

More than
teammates.

Badminton brought us together, but our friendship didn't stop when practice ended. We even organized a night hike together — carrying the same team spirit beyond the court.

I love how a shared interest can turn strangers into friends — and teammates into a community.
THE POINT ISN'T JUST THE POINT.

Keep playing.
Keep connecting.

For me, badminton has always been about more than winning. It's the people, the memories, and the joy of finding something worth coming back to.
